messages:
alex: Heads-up — hit sustained p99 latency spikes on long-context soak yesterday. Memory grows, then paging kicks in and p99 jumps ~3x. Running with FIFO eviction on runtime 2.4.1 (quantized model).
mel: which workload/test? dedicated infra or local repro?
alex: dedicated load test — mixed batches: a lot of short seqs plus a few 10k+ long contexts. FIFO eviction mode reproduced locally too.
sam: can you paste the profiler flame or top counts?
alex: profiler snapshot: ```hotspots:
cache_page_in: 48%
evict_scan: 36%
serialize_kv: 8%
kernel_dispatch: 4%
other: 4%
```
jen: hmm evict_scan that high suggests linear scanning on free list under pressure. FIFO probably scanning until it finds tombstone.
mel: LRU used to avoid scanning but was more CPU-heavy. Did you try LRU for the same mix?
alex: LRU reduced the p99 by ~40% at same load but CPU rose ~18%. More importantly, I observed correctness anomalies only with FIFO: some requests ended up attending tokens that didn't belong to them.
jen: whoa — correctness issue. logs?
alex: snippet from runtime logs: ```[kv] reuse_entry idx=1245 tombstone=0 last_tag=0x2 current_tag=0x5 WARN: tag_mismatch -> returning stale KV```
sam: that looks like reuse without clearing metadata. FIFO's reuse pointer wraps and reassigns slot without zeroing tag under high churn. LRU tends to evict least-recent but clears metadata as part of move.
mel: do we have a repro harness? a deterministic sequence that forces wrap-around?
alex: yes — small repro script that allocates many short contexts to fill slabs then interleave a long 12k context. I'll attach trace later. Quick command: ```TEST_LOAD=burst_long ./kv_stress --evict=fifo --slots=131072 --seed=42```
jen: batching heuristics probably amplify this: when many short requests are batched, we do prefix/KV reuse aggressively which changes timing of when slots become eligible. The FIFO pointer can race with async page-in.
sam: profile with lock contention counters? I saw queue waits on evict_lock in the trace. That explains jitter. Evict scan holding lock while doing zeroing/serialize increases p99.
mel: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) enable strict-zero-on-reuse in FIFO (costly but safe), 2) raise cache-drain threshold to avoid wrap in hot path, 3) prefer LRU for mixed workloads via routing policy.
jen: also add a debug assert that verifies key->tag matches request context in dev builds. If mismatch, log full KV payload and stack.
alex: I'll open a PR with strict-zero toggle + debug assert. Will also add unit test that simulates wrap and checks for stale tags.
sam: I'll run perf before/after on the dedicated cluster and collect heap/kvmem profiles.
mel: for longer-term: consider hybrid policy — FIFO for pure-streaming cheap workloads, LRU for mixed heavy reuse. Also investigate making zeroing lazy but atomic tag swap so we don't need full memset under lock.
jen: agreed. Also we should add an e2e regression test in CI that runs the mixed-burst scenario nightly.
infra-bot: deploy notice: runtime/2.4.1 was rolled out to dedicated-nyc-1 at 2026-03-03T02:12:00Z (no errors reported).
alex: thanks — action items: alex -> PR (strict-zero + assert), sam -> perf runs, mel -> policy gating doc, jen -> CI e2e test. Target: patch + perf results by next Wed. :thumbsup:
